group_intro: Companion to the seven-model 10,000-path fixed-calibration study. This report keeps only Heston and Heston–Merton, which are calibrated to listed calls (Fourier NLS). Rankings are within this pair; they are not compared here with return-based models.
Companies are SPY, AAPL, MSFT, and AMZN. No new calibration or LSM. Every number is the stored cell from V3_1p5y_fixed_empirical_study.

filter_funnel.note: Same filters for every model. No model-specific data selection.
